name: Corpus Delicti
description: Dive into the atmospheric world of post-punk with French band Corpus Delicti. Experience their dark, driving sound in the intimate setting of Auditório CCOP.
longDescription:
On May 2nd, 2026, the Auditório CCOP hosts Corpus Delicti, a French band known for their contributions to the post-punk and gothic rock genres. Formed in the early 1990s, the group established a distinct sound characterized by melancholic melodies, driving rhythms, and atmospheric textures. Their performance in Porto offers an opportunity to engage with their influential body of work, which has resonated with audiences interested in the darker, more introspective side of alternative music.

Attendees can expect a focused musical experience within the intimate setting of the Auditório CCOP. The venue's design typically supports clear acoustics, allowing for a direct engagement with the band's sound. The concert is likely to appeal to fans of post-punk and gothic rock, as well as those interested in the history and evolution of these musical styles. The atmosphere will be conducive to listening, emphasizing the band's performance.

This is a ticketed event. Further details regarding ticket purchase and availability will be announced closer to the date. The Auditório CCOP is located in central Porto, within walking distance of several public transport links.
